title: Free Edition
description: Adds a new dimension where everything is wool based of the free edition meme
body:
### **Free Edition**
Free Edition is mod based off the Minecraft Free Edition meme. This mod adds 3 new dimensions and free blocks. Some blocks like the free chest have a gui. To go to the Free Dimension you will
need to make a portal frame out of black wool and a igniter crafted with white wool and flint and steel.
This mod is not essential to have, its just a fun mod you can try.
This mod is under development so please tell me feedback or bugs in the comments
This mod was made in MCreator
